name: CS-321
description: CS-321 was a tan-colored RA-7 protocol droid that was owned by Weequay pirates during the Clone Wars, a war between the Galactic Republic and the breakaway Confederacy of Independent Systems. He was destroyed during a battle between the two parties.

data.name: CS-321
data.death: 20 BBY, during the Rescue of Adi Gallia
